fullPassage: Honey can be eaten by itself or mixed with other ingredients. Natural or pure honey has had no additives, preservatives or synthetic ingredients added. Also referred to as 'undiluted', it is usually more expensive than diluted honeys. Natural honey can also be called 'blended honey', which honeys from various sources are blended together — not by the bees, but by human processors and distributors in stages after the honey has been collected. Blending is frequently done for taste as well as marketing reasons, especially since some consumers find the darker honeys too strong. Mixing different types of honey together can make it more palatable, and also gives a more uniform flavour — this is an important consideration for producers and retailers, who feel the need to guarantee reliable, unsurprising (typically mild) flavours to their customers. Clover is one of the most popular honeys in the U.S., and its mild flavour and taste have become familiar to many Americans.

① for taste as well as marketing reasons ← 정답: 블렌딩이 맛과 마케팅 두 가지 이유로 이루어진다
② from various sources by human processors: 본문 단어 사용하나 블렌딩 이유가 아닌 방법 설명
③ more expensive than diluted honeys: 가격 비교는 천연 꿀 설명이지 블렌딩 이유 아님
④ by the bees in stages after collection: 벌이 아닌 사람이 블렌딩하며, 이유가 아닌 과정 설명

questions.passage: Honey can be eaten by itself or mixed with other ingredients. Natural or pure honey has had no additives, preservatives or synthetic ingredients added. Also referred to as 'undiluted', it is usually more expensive than diluted honeys. Natural honey can also be called 'blended honey', which honeys from various sources are blended together — not by the bees, but by human processors and distributors in stages after the honey has been collected. Blending is frequently done for taste as well as marketing reasons, especially since some consumers find the darker honeys too strong. Mixing different types of honey together can make it more palatable, and also gives a more uniform flavour — this is an important consideration for producers and retailers, who feel the need to guarantee __________ to their customers. Clover is one of the most popular honeys in the U.S., and its mild flavour and taste have become familiar to many Americans.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 다양한 종류의 꿀을 함께 / 신뢰할 수 있고 놀랍지 않은(보통 순한) 풍미 / 너무 강한 어두운 꿀 / 다양한 출처에서 함께 블렌드된 꿀
det.analysis:
① different types of honey together: 블렌딩의 재료 설명이지 보장 대상이 아님
② reliable, unsurprising (typically mild) flavours ← 정답: 생산자가 고객에게 보장하려는 것
③ the darker honeys too strong: 소비자의 불만 원인이지 보장 대상이 아님
④ honeys from various sources are blended together: 블렌딩 과정 설명이지 보장 대상이 아님
det.tip: 생산자가 guarantee하려는 것이 무엇인지 파악
